title: WIST Catalog Envelope (WIST-1)
description: A Publisher's signed statement of one Collection's Item list: its size, the Merkle root over its Items and the hash of its root tree file (WIST-1 §3.5).

wist_version.description: Release-version spelling only. WIST-1 sections 3.1 and 7 separately require supported-major validation; minor and patch differences alone do not reject.

publisher.description: Signed Publisher identity under WIST-1 section 3.8; must equal its own Canonical Host. The pattern alone does not validate A-labels.

collection.description: The Collection name; a Declaration without collections names only default (WIST-1 §3.5).

generated_at.description: The whole-second literal-Z profile of WIST-3 section 3.1; the binding window of WIST-1 section 5.1 is read at this instant (WIST-1 §3.5). The pattern alone does not establish calendar validity.

size.description: The number of Items listed; at most catalog_items_max, whose default is the maximum here (WIST-1 §3.5).

root.description: The Merkle Tree Hash over the Items' leaves in ascending octet order of key; SHA-256("") for an empty Collection (WIST-1 §4).

tree.description: SHA-256 of the octets of the root tree file (WIST-1 §4).
